title: Constructible Hom pairs for the specified structural exceptional image
statement: Fix the finite-field datum $D$, a prime $\ell\ne D.p$, a realization family $R$, and a separated finite-type model $X$ [lem-sf-adic-qbar-constructible-realization, lem-sf-weil-native-exceptional-forgetful]. Write $Y=X\times_{D.k_0}D.k$ and $a:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}D.k$. For every normalized constructible exceptional system $S$ for $a$, every compactification $c$ of $a$, and every object $M$ of the common finite-stage constructible category $C_Y$, the literal pair $(M,S_c^!\Omega)$ belongs to the permitted common-stage Hom-pair domain [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Here $S_c^!$ is the closed-stage right adjoint of the specified system and $\Omega$ is the specified geometricPointOmega, the actual common-stage coefficient unit. Thus the actual common-stage derived internal Hom, rather than a newly chosen duality functor, is defined at this pair.

source.place: Last paragraph: field-stage duality and transport thm-coef-qbar-verdier; native dual comparison step 1 and the exceptional identification in cor-coef-verdier-weil-equivariance.

proof.text: Apply the common-stage Verdier theorem to Y. Its InternalHom datum supplies constructibility into its dualizing object. Its Dualizing clause identifies that object with the structural exceptional image of the coefficient unit.

Compare the compact-support left functors of this exceptional datum and the specified system using their normalized finite-stage realizations. Uniqueness of adjoints gives the right comparison. The unit normalizations identify its input with geometricPointOmega. Represent the resulting object isomorphism at one common finite field. Invariance of rational internal-Hom constructibility under isomorphism and further scalar extension gives the literal compositum predicate for M and the specified structural exceptional image.

proof_origin.place: Explicit interface refinement of native dual comparison step 1
